info.name: QOR API — MVP Core
info.description:
Postman collection covering every route registered in qor-api as of Milestone 2 (Social & Notifications, Phase 5a/5b/5c) — 52 routes across routes/api_v1.php (fan-facing, /api/v1/*) and routes/api_admin_v1.php (admin surface, /api/admin/v1/*). Originally created at the admin-login slice (ADMIN-28-30, 36 routes) and extended with Milestone 2's Favorites, Friendships, Sharing, Notification Preferences, and Profile Extensions endpoints (T88). See ARCHITECTURE.md §8.9.

Auth: fan-guarded routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{fan_token}}`; admin-guarded routes (including Super-Admin-only approval routes) use `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_token}}`. Public routes need no Authorization header. Obtain a fan token via 'Login (Fan)' (or 'Register (Fan)' + login); obtain an admin token via 'Login (Admin)' after registering a Venue/Promoter (or seeding a Super Admin row directly) — login succeeds regardless of the account's approval status (ADMIN-28).

request.description: AUTH-01/AUTH-02/AUTH-05 — fan self-registration with email/password, terms acceptance required. Public, no token needed.
AUTH-09/AUTH-11 — returning-fan login. Public, no token needed. Response contains `token` — copy into the `fan_token` collection/environment variable for subsequent authenticated requests.

AUTH-06/AUTH-07/AUTH-08 — Google signup/login. Public, no token needed. NOTE: current implementation trusts the client-supplied google_id/email/name as-is (Google ID token server-side verification not yet implemented — known gap, see PR description).
AUTH-12 — ends the fan's current session by revoking the current Sanctum access token. Requires fan bearer token.
AUTH-13/AUTH-14 — requests a password reset link. Public, no token needed. Always returns a generic success message (no account enumeration).
AUTH-15/AUTH-16 — confirms a password reset using the token from the reset-link email. Public, no token needed.
AUTH-01 — resends the account-verification email. Public, no token needed.

AUTH-01 — signed email-verification link, clicked from the verification email; not called directly with a bearer token. `id` is the fan's user id, `hash` is the signed verification hash from the email link.

AUTH-19 — signed link confirming an in-progress email change, clicked from the confirmation email; not called directly with a bearer token. `id` is the fan's user id, `hash` is the signed hash from the email link.
AUTH-17 — display core profile fields. Requires fan bearer token.
AUTH-18/AUTH-19 — edit username/phone/email (email change triggers re-verification). All fields optional/nullable. Requires fan bearer token.

AUTH-18 — upload a new profile picture. Requires fan bearer token.

NOTE: multipart/form-data upload — field name `picture` (required, must be an image file). Set the request Body tab to `form-data` in Postman and attach a file under key `picture`.
AUTH-25 — LGPD data-subject access request: returns the fan's stored personal data. Requires fan bearer token.
AUTH-25 — LGPD data-subject export request: returns a full JSON export of the fan's data. Requires fan bearer token.
AUTH-25 — LGPD data-subject deletion request: deletes the fan's account and revokes the current access token. No request body. Requires fan bearer token.
AUTH-25 — LGPD data-subject consent revocation. `consent_type` must be one of: terms, location. Requires fan bearer token.
DISC-01/DISC-02/DISC-03/DISC-14/DISC-15/DISC-16 — cursor-paginated, soonest-first upcoming events, optionally filtered by city and/or genre. Public, no token needed. All query params optional.

DISC-07/DISC-08/DISC-09/DISC-10/DISC-11/DISC-13 — full event detail including tagged promoters. Public, no token needed. `id` must be a valid seeded event id (e.g. from `php artisan db:seed`, or from a prior List Upcoming Events response).

ADMIN-28/ADMIN-29 — Venue Admin/Promoter/Super Admin login. Public, no token needed. Succeeds regardless of the account's approval status (Pending Approval/Approved/Rejected/Suspended alike) — approval gating happens at write-action endpoints, not at login. Wrong password or unknown email both return 401 with the same generic message. Response contains `token` — copy into the `admin_token` collection/environment variable for subsequent authenticated requests.
ADMIN-30 — ends the admin's current session by revoking the current Sanctum access token. Requires admin bearer token.
ADMIN-01 — venue self-registration; account created as Pending Approval. Public, no token needed.

request.description:
ADMIN-25 — the logged-in venue admin's own venue profile. All fields optional/nullable. Requires admin bearer token.

Accepts a `city` field (one of: vitoria, vila_velha, serra, cariacica) plus text fields below. Also accepts an optional `image` file upload (multipart/form-data) for the venue's image — omitted from this raw JSON example; switch to form-data and attach key `image` to update the image.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Clube Náutico Vitória - Novo Espaço",
  "description": "Casa de shows e eventos na orla de Vitória, com novo espaço ao ar livre.",
  "address": "Av. Beira Mar, 600, Vitória - ES",
  "city": "vitoria",
  "contact_phone": "27988886666",
  "contact_email": "contato@clubenauticovix.com.br"
}

request.description: ADMIN-05 — promoter self-registration; account created as Pending Approval. Public, no token needed.
ADMIN-25 — the logged-in promoter's own profile. All fields optional/nullable. Requires admin bearer token.
ADMIN-21 — list events created by the logged-in venue/promoter admin. Requires admin bearer token.

ADMIN-13/ADMIN-14 — create a new event as Draft. Paid events (`is_free: false`) require `ticket_url`. Requires admin bearer token.

Also accepts an optional `cover_image` file upload (multipart/form-data) — omitted from this raw JSON example; switch to form-data and attach key `cover_image` to include a cover image.

request.description: ADMIN-14/ADMIN-15 — moves a Draft event to Pending Review. No request body. `id` must be an event owned by the logged-in admin. Requires admin bearer token.

ADMIN-21 — edit own event. All fields optional/nullable (partial edit); which fields may change per event status is enforced in the domain layer. `id` must be an event owned by the logged-in admin. Requires admin bearer token.

Also accepts an optional `cover_image` file upload (multipart/form-data) — omitted from this raw JSON example.

ADMIN-21 — duplicates an existing event as a new Draft with a new `starts_at`. `id` must be an event owned by the logged-in admin. Requires admin bearer token. NOTE: validated inline in the controller (no dedicated FormRequest class) — only `starts_at` is accepted.
ADMIN-22 — organizer cancellation of their own event. No request body. `id` must be an event owned by the logged-in admin. Requires admin bearer token.
ADMIN-21 — permanently deletes an own event. No request body. `id` must be an event owned by the logged-in admin. Requires admin bearer token.
ADMIN-07 — Super Admin account-approval queue: list pending Venue/Promoter accounts. Paginated via `page` query param. Requires Super Admin bearer token.

ADMIN-08/ADMIN-09/ADMIN-10 — Super Admin approves/rejects/suspends a Venue or Promoter account, with an auditable decision. `accountType` is one of: venue, promoter. `outcome` is one of: approved, rejected, suspended, suspension_lifted. Requires Super Admin bearer token.
ADMIN-17 — Super Admin event-publish queue: list events Pending Review. Paginated via `page` query param. Requires Super Admin bearer token.

ADMIN-17/ADMIN-22 — Super Admin approves an event to Published, rejects it back with feedback, or force-cancels it. `outcome` is one of: approved, rejected, force_cancelled. Requires Super Admin bearer token.

ADMIN-26 — Venue/Promoter dashboard: per-event stats for the logged-in admin's own events. view_count/favorite_count/ticket_click_count/interested_count are currently always null (Favorites & Social milestone not yet built). Requires admin bearer token.

FAV-01/FAV-02 — toggles the logged-in fan's favorite status for an event (favorites it if not already favorited, unfavorites it otherwise). No request body. `id` must be a valid event id — returns 404 with `{"message": "Evento não encontrado."}` otherwise. Requires fan bearer token.
FAV-03 — cursor-paginated list of the logged-in fan's favorited events. `cursor` query param optional. Requires fan bearer token.
SOC-01 — sends a friend request to another fan. `recipient_user_id` must be an existing user id (error: "Usuário destinatário não encontrado." if not found). Requires fan bearer token.
SOC-02 — lists pending friend requests received by the logged-in fan. Requires fan bearer token.
SOC-02 — accepts a pending friend request addressed to the logged-in fan. No request body. `id` is the friendship request id. Requires fan bearer token.

SOC-02 — rejects a pending friend request addressed to the logged-in fan. No request body. `id` is the friendship request id. Requires fan bearer token. Response: `{"message": "Solicitação de amizade recusada."}`.
SOC-03 — removes an existing friendship with `userId`. No request body. Requires fan bearer token. Response: `{"message": "Amizade removida."}`.
SOC-02 — cursor-paginated list of the logged-in fan's accepted friendships. `cursor` query param optional. Requires fan bearer token.

SOC-04 — lists the logged-in fan's friends who favorited/are interested in this event. `id` must be a valid event id — returns 404 with `{"message": "Evento não encontrado."}` otherwise. Requires fan bearer token.

SOC-05 — shares an event with a friend (triggers a notification to the friend). `friend_user_id` must be an existing user id (error: "Amigo não encontrado." if not found). `id` must be a valid event id — returns 404 with `{"message": "Evento não encontrado."}` otherwise. Requires fan bearer token. Response: `{"message": "Evento compartilhado com sucesso."}`.
NOTIF-06/NOTIF-07 — the logged-in fan's notification preferences. Defaults are returned if none have been saved yet. Requires fan bearer token.

NOTIF-06/NOTIF-07 — updates the logged-in fan's notification preferences. All fields optional/sometimes-present. `trigger_event_changed_cancelled` is always-on and not togglable (NOTIF-07's always-fires rule) — it is silently ignored even if sent. Requires fan bearer token.

body.raw:
{
  "push_enabled": true,
  "email_enabled": true,
  "silence_all": false,
  "trigger_nearby_reminder": true,
  "trigger_friend_interest": true,
  "trigger_new_regional": false
}

request.description: PREF-01 — the logged-in fan's saved address (used for nearby-event discovery radius). Returns `{"data": null}` if none saved yet. Requires fan bearer token.

PREF-01 — sets/updates the logged-in fan's address. `city` is one of: vitoria, vila_velha, serra, cariacica (error: "Cidade inválida." otherwise). `state` required (2-letter UF). `street`/`number`/`complement` optional/nullable. Requires fan bearer token.
PREF-02/PREF-03 — the logged-in fan's favorite genres and search radius (km). Requires fan bearer token.

PREF-02/PREF-03 — updates the logged-in fan's favorite genres and/or search radius. Both fields optional/independent (`sometimes`) — send only the one(s) you want to change. `genre_ids` must reference existing genres (error: "Gênero inválido." otherwise). `radius_km` must be 1-100 (errors: "O raio de busca deve ser de pelo menos 1 km." / "...no máximo 100 km."). Requires fan bearer token.
